name: formula
description: Calculated rotation distance for Z-axis lead screw

name: pitch
description: Distance between threads on the lead screw

name: number_of_threads
description: Number of separate threads (starts) on the lead screw

name: common_t8_screws
description: T8x8 (2mm pitch, 4 starts) = 8mm; T8x4 (2mm pitch, 2 starts) = 4mm; T8x2 (2mm pitch, 1 start) = 2mm

name: common_values
description: 2mm (T8x2 single start), 4mm (T8x4 dual start), 8mm (T8x8 quad start)

name: usage_note
description: Set rotation_distance in [stepper_z] section of printer.cfg. Common for Z-axis on Ender 3, CR-10, and many CoreXY printers.

name: klipper_reference
description: From Klipper docs: rotation_distance = screw_pitch * number_of_separate_threads
